title: Packaged Project document keeper
summary: Shared trusted persistence for delivery, design, annotations, shotlist and Quanta. Packages own domain rules; Runtime owns file placement, companion sections, revision fencing, receipts and reconciliation.

carrier.notes: Gate execution_id is execution_ plus the first 32 hex characters of SHA-256 over canonical product/account/session/root-turn/turn/capability/resource-scope data. Scope includes project_revision and authorization context. A proven-not-started step terminalizes RELEASED; the identical request replays its failed outcome, rather than running again.

replaceability.why: The module holds Project integrity or trusted execution authority.

reach.notes: Trusted Runtime seam, not an additional grant to a creator Luc.

operations.name: packaged_document_from

input.description: Python function-bearing package descriptor, not wire JSON. Functions are trusted host callables; their serialized representation is not yet defined.

operations.notes: No local deadline is enforced. Returned PackagedDocument contains callable members and a Runtime-owned DocumentPlace. The object output is a draft projection, not permission for package code to choose storage paths.

operations.name: validated_patch
operations.notes: No local deadline is enforced. Runs the package validate callable. Package ToolRefused codes pass through DocumentRefused; no finite independent error list exists at this generic seam.

operations.name: applied
operations.notes: No local deadline is enforced. Pure package application. Only the mapped section and its allowed companion sections can change. Shotlist may return timeline clips; Runtime validates and orders them. Other package refusals are dynamic and not enumerated here.

operations.name: shown_beside
operations.notes: No local deadline is enforced. Extra display fields cannot shadow session_id, project_id, project_revision, error or the document label. Package refusals remain dynamic.

operations.name: bind_document_patch
operations.notes: No local deadline is enforced. Output is a trusted DurableSideEffectRunner, projected as an object; package callbacks determine additional refusal codes. A governed commit advances the Project revision and can replay the exact execution. Document and descriptor are separate file replacements; there is no one crash-atomic commit of document, expected_project_revision and client_op_id result. This write cannot be layered under the self-Luc run gate today.

invariants.text: A package cannot name an arbitrary output file or mutate a section outside its DocumentPlace.
For governed calls, a definitive no-side-effect failure is RELEASED and the identical execution identity replays that failure. A new attempt must not be disguised as a retry.

break: An unhandled exception, invalid output, or failed declared artifact check.
failure.notes: The original reports failure today. The self-Luc run gate and original fallback are requirements for a future replacement, not a promise this seam already implements.

conformance.notes: No replacement conformance runner exists for this seam.

known_deviations.text: A governed commit advances the Project revision and can replay the exact execution. Document and descriptor are separate file replacements; there is no one crash-atomic commit of document, expected_project_revision and client_op_id result. This write cannot be layered under the self-Luc run gate today.

Generic package refusal codes and callable-bearing descriptors have no closed wire schema. Binding them requires the package-specific tools contracts; a replacement must not invent a universal error vocabulary.
The execution journal stores immutable effect results separately from Project persistence. It does not make the Project document, revision and client_op_id result record one atomic commit.

descriptor.description: Python function-bearing package descriptor, not wire JSON. Functions are trusted host callables; their serialized representation is not yet defined.
